title: Two-fluid Vehicle-mounted Portable Aromatherapy Diffuser
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This dual‑liquid car air freshener is suitable for cars, homes, and offices, combining quiet operation, timed control, and negative‑ion air purification. Featuring a retro‑minimalist industrial design and touch‑control operation, it delivers a long‑lasting fragrance experience while effectively killing bacteria and purifying the air, creating a comfortable and healthy breathing environment.

Specifications:
Materials: Plastic/Metal
Colors: Black plastic, white plastic, black metal, silver metal, gray metal, and other custom colors
Shape: Cylindrical
Control Method: Touch operation
Noise Level: Less than 36 dB
Water Tank Capacity: 0.5 liters or less
Applicable Area: Under 10 square meters
Timer Settings: 2 to 8 hours
Functions: Negative ion generation, aromatherapy, sleep aid, mist diffusion, automatic scenting, antibacterial air purification, silent operation
Number of Mist Outlets: 1
Power Supply: Rechargeable
Dimensions: 69 × 120 mm


Packing list:
Scent diffuser + Charging cable + Instruction manual * 1
